text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Across the line!!! And the winner is—
(WOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I will never...... never forget.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Today's Tenno Sho (Spring)—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And once again, I'll keep the chain 
connected.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
For the future of Mejiro and myself... 
without fail...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (The strain is unbelievable...! But—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(I'm all right— I can clearly sense my own 
outline...—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(A pounding heart. Rough breathing. 
Trembling legs. I can measure all of it, 
accurately...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's crystal clear. Both her will and her 
thoughts—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(And above all— I gained more experience 
than ever before...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Competing against McQueen-san across 
these 3,200 meters is an irreplaceable 
experience for me—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(Today's race will definitely make me 
stronger. I am certain of it...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(That's why I can still stand. I can make 
it back safely—!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Even after running, Ikuno Dictus is 
totally composed. She really lives up to 
her reputation...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan
text_block_list.text:
You're really amazing...! Can't you run in 
just about any race now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ――Ikuno-san.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: McQueen-san—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(...What an incredible person. Running 
that distance, and their breath is already 
catching up—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That was truly... a splendid race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Facing every race without fear, and 
standing tall until the very end—that is 
your strength.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Today, on the very same turf, I truly 
felt its essence."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so very much... for running in 
this Tenno Sho (Spring)."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Me too—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I will take pride... in having run with 
you today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Forever and always, from here on out—

"...And so, Ikuno Dictus successfully 
completed the grueling 3,200m challenge, 
proving her trademark 'stability'—"
—A few days later.

Ikuno Dictus was to be interviewed by the 
media regarding her upcoming race 
schedule—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
――So your next goals are to run in the 
Yasuda Kinen and Takarazuka Kinen... is 
that right!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes.
(Murmur, murmur, murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Running the Osaka Hai and Tenno Sho 
(Spring), and on top of that the Yasuda 
Kinen and Takarazuka Kinen... Wouldn't 
that be an unprecedentedly packed 
schedule...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
"This appears to be an extraordinarily 
high-risk plan... May I ask what your 
intention is!?"
choice_data_list:
It is about demonstrating our strengths 
through results.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: My strong points...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“—Through meticulous management and 
thorough maintenance, we will see this 
race plan through to a safe completion.”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Through this, I intend to prove it. Our 
greatest strength—our 'management 
capability.'

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Ikuno Dictus is running both the Yasuda 
Kinen and Takarazuka Kinen after the Tenno 
Sho (Spring)!? That's insane, she's really 
doing whatever she wants...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Man, but if it's Ikuno Dictus, she 
honestly might run the whole thing without 
breaking a sweat...

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"‘Management skills’, huh... You know, 
wouldn't it be great if Ikuno Dictus could 
share her management know-how with 
everyone?"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Well, wishing everyone could run without 
injury like Ikuno Dictus... yeah, that's 
fair.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Phew...—

...Ikuno Dictus has not yet fully 
recovered from the fatigue of the Tenno 
Sho (Spring). It cannot be denied that the 
situation remains unpredictable.

Over the past few days, we've been 
handling recovery even more cautiously 
than usual, checking in with 'IRON WILL' 
every step of the way.
choice_data_list:
Let's do stretches and the foam roller for 
a little longer today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Understood.

And today, after conducting thorough 
"maintenance," at the meeting—

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
“—I have updated the current risk 
assessment and list of rival Umamusume to 
prepare for in the Yasuda Kinen. Please 
review them.”

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...As expected, drastically shifting her 
training regimen for the Yasuda Kinen 
right now carries far too much risk."
choice_data_list:
We'll have to take it step by step. I'll 
adjust the contents.

text_block_list.text:
"...The 'Yasuda Kinen' is at Ikuno 
Dictus's preferred distance, but we must 
take into account that she's coming off 
the 'Tenno Sho (Spring)'."

Transitioning from long-distance to mile 
race prep is a change so drastic it's 
almost like switching sports entirely. We 
need to manage this carefully without 
rushing.
choice_data_list:
Regardless, this rival Umamusume to watch 
out for—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Yamanin Zephyr-san, is it? ...Judging by 
her recent performances, I'd say that's a 
fair evaluation."

"Yamanin Zephyr. An Umamusume who's been 
making rapid strides lately, and is slated 
to run in the Yasuda Kinen."

Her demeanor gave a graceful impression, 
yet her running was truly a ferocious 
gale.

She is one of the Umamusume that racing 
fans have high hopes for, making her the 
greatest threat in the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Having experienced both the Osaka Hai and 
the Tenno Sho (Spring), what kind of 
running will I be capable of in the Yasuda 
Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
What kind of race I'll be able to run with 
Zephyr-san.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to it too!
I'm looking forward to it too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Let's aim for it together.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Without rushing, but steadily. Heading 
into the Yasuda Kinen in peak 
condition...!

The next goal is the Yasuda Kinen, which 
crowns the ultimate miler...

"I will definitely prove it there. The 
evolution and true value of Ikuno Dictus's 
running!"
